summary.text: On Amonkhet, the Second Sun aligns with the horns of the God-Pharaoh's throne and the Gate to the Afterlife opens, revealing a crypt of preserved dead instead of paradise as Nicol Bolas returns to claim his army of Eternals.
The Gatewatch is defeated by Bolas, Bontu is struck down after betraying her fellow gods, and Hazoret, the last living god, leads the survivors of Naktamun into the desert.
Samut's spark ignites as she fights alongside the mortals, and the survivors later reclaim Naktamun and begin rebuilding.
